title: The Thousand and First [ALPHA]
description: Found a faction through a water rite, plant and govern settlements, and build districts across ten typed plot categories in S/M/L/XL sizes, with buildings tiered by style, creed, materials, and technology. Grow food, manage water, trade between cities, answer threats, and optionally leave a legacy across worlds. Single-player only, so there is no multiplayer or user-moderation surface.
author: AussieWarGod
